tiers.summary: Aldo Brenner parried Adrien Kovalenko's shot from inside the area in the first minute, and United won a corner in the 3rd minute after Matteo Rivas put the ball out. The rest of the opening spell was quiet, and it stayed 0–0.

Rory Calloway was flagged offside in the 6th minute, and Brenner parried a Callum Brightwell shot in the 9th. Kai Ashworth fouled Brightwell near the Riverton Rovers area in the 10th minute; still 0–0.

Rory Calloway fouled Moses Ekwueme near the United area in the 12th minute, and Callum Brightwell was booked for a foul on Dario Mensforth in the 13th. United had more of the ball over the 13th and 14th minutes, but there were no attempts and it remained 0–0.
Yusuf Karabey shot off target with his left foot in the 18th minute, the only attempt of the period. United spent much of the 20th minute in Riverton Rovers' half; still 0–0.
Riverton Rovers' first attempt came in the 21st minute, when Bruno Castellane blocked an Rory Calloway shot. Theo Marchetti shot wide from inside the area in the 25th minute; still 0–0.
Sami Lindqvist gave Riverton Rovers the lead in the 28th minute with a left-footed finish after an error by Oskar Lindgard. Dario Mensforth then shot wide in the 30th minute; Riverton Rovers led 1–0.
Riverton Rovers had most of the ball in the 32nd and 33rd minutes, and Viktor Halloran parried a left-footed shot from Rory Calloway in the 35th. Riverton Rovers led 1–0.

A Matteo Rivas error led to a Moses Ekwueme shot off target in the 37th minute. United won corners in the 39th and 40th minutes, both taken by Adrien Kovalenko, and Rory Calloway fouled Bruno Castellane in between; Riverton Rovers still led 1–0.
Riverton Rovers dominated the ball in the 42nd minute, and Viktor Halloran parried a Joel Hartigan shot from inside the area in the 44th minute. Riverton Rovers led 1–0.

United had the first three attempts of the match: Aldo Brenner parried shots from Adrien Kovalenko and Callum Brightwell, and Yusuf Karabey shot off target in the 18th minute. Brightwell was booked in the 13th minute, while Riverton Rovers had not yet attempted a shot. It was 0–0 after 20 minutes.

Sami Lindqvist opened the scoring in the 28th minute after a Oskar Lindgard error, and Dario Mensforth and Rory Calloway also had attempts, Calloway's 35th-minute shot parried by Viktor Halloran. United's Theo Marchetti and Moses Ekwueme shot off target, and United won two corners late in the period. Riverton Rovers led 1–0 after 40 minutes.

Aldo Brenner parried early shots from Adrien Kovalenko and Callum Brightwell, and Brightwell was booked in the 13th minute. Sami Lindqvist scored in the 28th minute after a Oskar Lindgard error, and Viktor Halloran later parried attempts from Rory Calloway and Joel Hartigan. Theo Marchetti was booked for a foul on Hartigan in stoppage time. Riverton Rovers led 1–0 at half-time, with five attempts each, three on target for Riverton Rovers to United's two, and possession at 51% to 49%.
The second half began quietly, until Ewan Tierney sent a big chance off target for United in the 50th minute. Jamal Whitcombe then fouled Rory Calloway; Riverton Rovers led 1–0.

Callum Brightwell was shown a second yellow card for a foul on Ilan Petrakis in the 52nd minute, reducing United to ten men, and Viktor Halloran then parried an Nico Barrowclough shot. Oskar Lindgard shot off target in the 54th minute; Riverton Rovers led 1–0.
A period without shots: United had almost all of the ball in the 57th minute, and Riverton Rovers had more of it from the 58th to the 60th. Riverton Rovers still led 1–0.
Bruno Castellane equalised for United in the 61st minute with a left-footed finish. Riverton Rovers had most of the ball afterwards without a shot, and it was 1–1.

Sami Lindqvist restored Riverton Rovers' lead in the 67th minute with a left-footed finish. Viktor Halloran then parried two Joel Hartigan shots in the 69th minute, the second a big chance after a Luca Ferrandi error; Riverton Rovers led 2–1.

Riverton Rovers had most of the ball in the 72nd and 73rd minutes, and Viktor Halloran parried an Nico Barrowclough shot in the 73rd minute before Enzo shot off target in the 74th. Rory Calloway also shot from inside the area in the 75th minute; Riverton Rovers led 2–1.
Viktor Halloran parried a big chance from Sami Lindqvist in the 77th minute. Bruno Castellane was booked for a foul on Joel Hartigan in the 80th minute; Riverton Rovers led 2–1.

Rory Calloway shot off target in the 83rd minute, and Sami Lindqvist sent a big chance off target in the 84th. Bruno Castellane fouled Dario Mensforth on the edge of the United area in the 85th minute; Riverton Rovers led 2–1.

Riverton Rovers won three corners, taken by Ilan Petrakis in the 86th minute and Felix Adeyinka in the 89th and 90th, but no shot followed. United had most of the ball in the 87th minute; Riverton Rovers led 2–1.

Ewan Tierney missed a big chance for United in the 50th minute, and Callum Brightwell's second yellow card in the 52nd left United with ten men. Viktor Halloran parried an Nico Barrowclough shot soon after, and Bruno Castellane equalised in the 61st minute. It was 1–1 after 65 minutes.

Sami Lindqvist put Riverton Rovers 2–1 up in the 67th minute, and Viktor Halloran parried shots from Joel Hartigan, Nico Barrowclough and Lindqvist. Bruno Castellane was booked in the 80th minute, and Lindqvist sent another big chance off target in the 84th. Riverton Rovers led 2–1 after 85 minutes.

Ewan Tierney missed a big chance for United in the 50th minute, and Callum Brightwell's second yellow card in the 52nd reduced United to ten men. Bruno Castellane equalised in the 61st minute before Sami Lindqvist scored again in the 67th to restore Riverton Rovers' lead. Viktor Halloran made several saves, including from Joel Hartigan and Lindqvist, and Castellane was booked in the 80th minute. Riverton Rovers won 2–1, with 16 attempts to 8, nine on target to three, and 53% possession.
